# Don't show me this again

Confirm the welcome note with "Don't show me this again" ticked, and it
stays hidden the next time this runbook opens. Another runbook's note with
the same `storageKey` still shows.

<Admonition
  id="welcome"
  type="info"
  title="Welcome!"
  description="This is your first time running this runbook."
  confirmationText="I've read the introduction"
  allowPermanentHide={true}
  storageKey="welcome-message"
/>

<Admonition id="always" type="note" description="This note has no storageKey, so it shows every time." confirmationText="Got it" />
